If the water overtops the emergency spill it is the town downstream. I have sent my family to the high school. I am telling you to send everyone to the high school. The high school is the high ground. Send them now. I will stay on the winch. I will call when the gate is closed or when the gate is not closed. North Dam out.'

Action taken by Gate House:
- Runner dispatched to downstream settlements at 03:45.
- Captain of the Gate notified 04:00.
- Evacuation to high ground (school) begun 04:15.

— Gate House.
